_comment: P2 MERGED constraints for lumina-strobe (LUM-DTR-STROBE-A), from research/power.json + drive-stage.json + energy-store.json + protection-sense.json + led-emitter.json + refdesign-pulsed-led-driver.json, reconciled with architecture/sheets.md. CANONICAL net names per sheets.md s1: power symbols are global and BARE (GND, +48V_SW, +12V, +3V3); root-crossed signals are /NAME; sheet-internal signals are /<sheet>/NAME. FOUR MERGE DECISIONS. (1) research/power.json's /LED_A is DELETED, not renamed: nothing sits between the bank positive terminal and harness pin 1, so it was an alias of /VBANK, and a declared voltage net that is absent from the netlist makes check_creepage hard-error. (2) /drive/ISNS carries the 2.6 A declaration but is deliberately ABSENT from voltages: it is a 0-0.52 V node, so check_creepage treats it as 0 V and demands the full 48 V clearance from /drive/LED_K across the pass FET, which is correct. (3) power[] currents are reconciled to the FINAL operating point of power_tree.md, not to research/power.json: +48V_SW is 1.0 A (the carrier eFuse fault ceiling on the stub UPSTREAM of the daughter's own 0.20 A limiter), not 0.6 A. (4) thermal[] powers come from the 38.0 V string and the 44.5 V bank ceiling, and dt_c is 69 = Tj_design 125 C minus the 56 C af internal air of ICD s7.6 - NOT the corpus default of 40. TWO MANDATORY P5 STEPS, both with exact recipes in architecture/stackup.md s7. (a) placement.keepouts BELOW ARE IN THE ICD FRAME (board top-left = origin). board_init does NOT place the outline at (0,0) - the origin comes from the packed component bbox - so after board_init, read reports/board_init.json.outline_bbox = [ex1,ey1,ex2,ey2] and ADD (ex1,ey1) to every rect. They are declared rather than omitted because an absent keepout lets a part land in the RJ45 notch or the antenna column. (b) planes ship WITHOUT regions and MUST be given the three-rectangle-per-layer regions of stackup.md s7 so the antenna column (88,25)-(100,55) carries NO plane copper on either inner layer; a full-board pour there detunes the carrier's ESP32-S3 antenna 11 mm below. ONE P5/P7 TRAP carried from the carrier: rules_gen never reads the voltages key, so nothing makes the P7 router honour the ICD rev A2 0.635 mm 48 V clearance - add the hand-written .kicad_dru rule of stackup.md s2.1, keyed on A.NetName (A.Net silently matches nothing). check_creepage demands only 0.60 mm, so a 0.635 mm layout passes P8 by construction but is NOT enforced by it. GND is deliberately NOT a power entry: it is a plane, and declaring it would make check_current demand IPC width on every GND stub; the requirement is structural instead (solid In1 + In2 GND, 12 connector pins for the return).
